text:
sophie: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: what's the concrete ETA for APAC GPU region readiness and will the autoscaler allow short bursts during initial ramp? Need to update partner comms.

arjun: We're aiming for soft-availability in APAC on Aug 15 (internal), customer opt-in Aug 22. Autoscaler will allow a temporary burst cap ~15% for first 14 days to smooth onboarding.

sophie: thanks. any changes to billing or quota accounting for those bursts?

arjun: Bursts are out-of-band: they won't count toward reserved commitments; detailed wording from billing incoming.

mike: Ops note: provisioning pipeline shows 6 hosts arriving to the APAC colo in ~11 days, then ~10 days to QA + staging. That aligns with the dates. We also have a standby cloud partner for emergency capacity.

jen: SRE concern: cross-region KV cache warming during burst failovers. Will we pre-warm hot prefixes?

arjun: yes 1 pre-warming plan during soft-availability; SRE (jen) to validate with warmers.

infra-bot: deploy/rollout-apac queued at 1741004360 1 status: pending

sophie: Action items: 1) Arjun publish short timeline doc by Fri EOD; 2) Jen to run cache-warm + failover test next Tue; 3) Billing to provide burst language (Mike to coordinate).

arjun: I'll post the timeline doc and add owners.

jen: I'll run the failover test Tue 23:00 UTC and post results here.

mike: I'll loop in billing and update the capacity tracker.

sophie: great, thanks all. leaving thread open for any after-call Qs.
